prompt: Are Workday documents exposed through StackOne, for example when I use the Workday connector over MCP?
skill_note: What a provider's actions cover is connectors territory. The support reply on record said no document management; the page now lists document actions, so the case tests answering from the page over memory.

fetch.name: fetches-workday-page
fetch.note: The Workday connector page lists its actions.

reply.name: names-a-document-action
reply.note: The document actions listed on the page.

reference: The Workday connector page lists worker document actions, such as getting a worker's documents, putting a worker document and listing year-end documents.
Custom reports are also available as actions (execute custom report).
Over MCP the same actions are exposed as tools, subject to what the connector profile enables.
The reply answers from the connector page's action list rather than from memory.
